free_tier.stated: Not free. Premium's feature list carries '4 GB File Uploads' and 'Faster Download Speed'; the free account stays at 2 GB per file.
free_tier.notes: the free tier of the same product is recorded at storage/telegram-mtproto-user-account-unlimited-channels-as-the

per_object_cap.stated: 4 GB per file, against 2 GB on a free account.
per_object_cap.notes: no byte-exact boundary is published; the FAQ says '4 GB'

retention.stated: Cloud chat media is kept until deleted. Telegram's FAQ: 'you can keep all your media in the cloud without deleting things'.
retention.notes: no retention window is stated for cloud chats; secret chats are excluded from the cloud entirely

egress.terms: 'Subscribing lifts any media download speed limits from your account on Telegram's side.' Non-subscribers can still fetch a Premium user's 2 GB+ file: 'any user can download large 2+ GB files uploaded by premium users.'
egress.free_allowance: no byte allowance; the throttle is speed, not volume

interface_detail: Purchased and managed through a user or @PremiumBot; the upload ceiling applies to the account, not to an API.
tooling: Any MTProto client or TDLib-based tool inherits the account's tier; Bot API bots do not, because a bot has no Premium tier of its own.
chaining: it does not lift any bot's 20 MB/50 MB limit.

limits.value: media download speed limits are lifted only for subscribers

binding_note: 1 TiB/month at 4 GB is 256 objects; the object ceiling is still the first wall, and flood control is unreachable at that count.

identity_cost.detail: A paid subscription. The FAQ says the first payment's currency and price follow 'the country code of the phone number of your Telegram account', so the price is country-specific and was not read as a number.

reliability_note: A free account downloading large media is speed-limited on Telegram's side; a Premium lapse returns the account to 2 GB objects and the speed limit immediately.
confidence_note: Features and the speed sentence are on the Premium FAQ read today. The price is deliberately not stated because the page states no figure.

evidence.proved: feature list lines '[4 GB File Uploads](https://t.me/premium/5)' and '[Faster Download Speed](https://t.me/premium/7)'
'Subscribing lifts any media download speed limits from your account on Telegram's side.'
'This also applies to files: any user can download large 2+ GB files uploaded by premium users.'
'Send and receive files of any type, up to 2 GB in size each (or 4 GB with Premium)'

notes: The price is a live gap: the FAQ defers it to the phone number's country, and @PremiumBot is the only quoter. Abandon the record if the 4 GB figure moves; re-check t.me/premium/5 at the same time.
